calculation.description: Cross-sectional z-score of each instrument's 20-day realized volatility relative to the other watchlist instruments on the same date. Positive = idiosyncratically high vol (risk-off candidate), negative = low vol (defensive). Lower values tended to predict higher forward returns.

metrics.note: Passes IC/ICIR admission gates; time-averaged cross-sectional Spearman vs library max_abs_mean_rho=0.878 (max_gain_20). Redundancy adjudicated by post-Miner gate from signal artifacts.

validation.regime_notes: Full-sample validation incl. 2020 crash, 2021 bull, 2022 bear, 2023-24 choppy, 2025-26 rally; artifacts through 2026-09-23 (fresh, not clamped). Regime ICs recorded in metrics.
